limits: Release evidence combines publisher tables, 91mobiles movie cards, and public metadata from ZEE5, Aha, Netflix, Prime Video, SonyLIV, ETV Win and Sun NXT. Actual audio tracks and regional subscriptions are not inspected.
Discovery uses the accessible source archives with bounded pagination; there is no one-year release cutoff. Future and tentative dates, series, non-Telugu originals and non-Indian films are excluded.
Duplicate film IDs are merged. Sorting uses the earliest reported Telugu OTT date across accepted listings; conflicting platform dates remain visible in coverage data.

Original language uses Wikidata, the matching TMDB public movie page, or explicit official Original audio labels; a publisher original-language label is the final fallback. Telugu must be a confirmed original language. Unknown or conflicting originals are excluded.

Film identities use Cinemeta, IMDb public suggestions, cast where listed, country consistency and year checks. Older-film relistings more than one calendar year after the film year are excluded from new-release dates. Unmatched or ambiguous titles remain excluded and are reported in coverage data.
A failed source uses its last successful recent snapshot while other sources update. If all release sources fail, publication stops and the previous deployment is preserved.
SV Telugu OTT returned HTTP 403 to automated requests during validation and is not an active source. Combined coverage is not a guarantee of every platform or every Telugu original.
